JANUS HENDERSON FUND MANAGEMENT UK LIMITED
THE HENDERSON FAR EAST INCOME LIMITED
The Company announces that it agreed on 4 November 2026 to allot 530,000 ordinary shares at a price of 247.5p per share.
These shares will be issued for cash on 5 November 2026, bringing the issued share capital and total voting rights at that date to 242,334,679.
Janus Henderson Secretarial Services UK Limited
